title: Chameleon eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7CFC5A'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#3DBA3A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1E7A34'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='tailGrad' cx='30%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8DFF6A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2C9438'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- curling tail -->
  <path d='M 30 72 C 18 76, 12 68, 14 60 C 16 53, 24 52, 26 58 C 27 62, 23 65, 21 62'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#tailGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little legs -->
  <path d='M 40 74 L 36 84 L 30 86' fill='none' stroke='#2FA83B' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M 62 74 L 66 84 L 73 86' fill='none' stroke='#2FA83B' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M 44 58 L 38 62 L 32 58' fill='none' stroke='#2FA83B' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='64' rx='24' ry='14' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- back crest bumps -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#A6FF7A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#A6FF7A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#A6FF7A'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='54' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#5CD84E'/>
  <!-- head crest -->
  <path d='M 70 44 Q 78 36 88 44 L 84 48 Q 78 43 72 47 Z' fill='#A6FF7A'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='50' r='5' fill='#E8FFD6'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#1B4D2A'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M 88 60 Q 84 64 79 62' fill='none' stroke='#1E7A34' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tongue going to snack -->
  <path d='M 89 62 Q 96 62 92 68 Q 88 73 82 70' fill='none' stroke='#FF6FA8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- snack: juicy little bug -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='71' r='5' fill='#FFB03A'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='71' r='2.5' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='1.6' fill='#C86E12'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='68' r='1.6' fill='#C86E12'/>
  <path d='M 77 66 L 74 62 M 83 66 L 86 62' stroke='#C86E12' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='2' fill='#C8FF9A'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='68' r='1.7' fill='#C8FF9A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='1.7' fill='#C8FF9A'/>
</svg>
